options.text: A compound containing a carbonyl carbon bonded to a heteroatom-containing substituent that can participate in acyl substitution.

options.label: B
options.text: A carboxylic acid derivative containing two acyl groups connected through an oxygen atom.

options.label: C
options.text: Base-promoted hydrolysis of an ester to give a carboxylate salt and an alcohol-derived product.

options.label: D
options.text: A reaction that moves an acyl group from one heteroatom-containing species to another nucleophile.

questions.correct_answer: A reaction that moves an acyl group from one heteroatom-containing species to another nucleophile.
questions.explanation: A reaction that moves an acyl group from one heteroatom-containing species to another nucleophile.

questions.question: Which organic chemistry term best matches this description? A carboxylic acid derivative containing two acyl groups connected through an oxygen atom.

options.label: A
options.text: acid chloride

options.label: B
options.text: saponification

options.label: C
options.text: acyl derivative

options.label: D
options.text: acid anhydride

questions.correct_answer: acid anhydride
questions.explanation: The best match is acid anhydride: A carboxylic acid derivative containing two acyl groups connected through an oxygen atom.

questions.question: You need to distinguish “nucleophilic acyl substitution” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.label: A
options.text: A mechanism in which nucleophilic addition to an acyl carbon is followed by elimination of a leaving group.

options.label: B
options.text: Base-promoted hydrolysis of an ester to give a carboxylate salt and an alcohol-derived product.

options.label: C
options.text: A highly reactive carboxylic acid derivative containing a carbonyl carbon bonded to chlorine.

options.label: D
options.text: A carboxylic acid derivative containing a carbonyl carbon bonded to an –OR group.

questions.correct_answer: A mechanism in which nucleophilic addition to an acyl carbon is followed by elimination of a leaving group.
questions.explanation: The distinguishing description for nucleophilic acyl substitution is: A mechanism in which nucleophilic addition to an acyl carbon is followed by elimination of a leaving group.

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D

questions.question: A student is reviewing a concept described as follows: A carboxylic acid derivative containing a carbonyl carbon bonded to an –OR group. Which label should the student place on this concept?
